title: More gardens, less carbon

location.extent: Complete local video; PNG is first-frame poster

slide_intent: Use a simple animated metaphor to make an abstract environmental message easier to grasp.
strategic_value: A leaf carried by a small figure can give Sweetgreen’s environmental voice a playful connection to real ingredients.
demonstration: A line-drawn person walks while holding a large green leaf between a farm scene and a bowl; the headline is distributed around the illustration.
practical_value: Balance legible, stationary campaign words with movement in one illustrative character.

content_islands.name: Headline
content_islands.spec: Distribute More, gardens, and less carbon around the central illustrated strip.

content_islands.name: Animated scene
content_islands.spec: Keep the farm and bowl at either end while the leaf-bearing figure moves between them.

reference_purposes.Expression: The clip combines vivid produce with an animated outlined person and green typography.
reference_purposes.Application: The campaign applies the illustration style to an environmental message.
